description:
Hi Friends, 
 Hope you are doing great, 
 
 I have an urgent requirement from one of my esteem client, I will appreciate if you can have an eye on the below requirement and send me your consultant updated profile ASAP. 
 
 Title: SharePoint Developer 
 Duration: 6 + Months 
 Location: Washington, DC for the first two months then moving to Reston, VA 
 
 MUST HAVE: Sharepoint 2013 and 2016, Office 365, looking for mid level (no too Jr. and not too senior) 
 
 Confer with business unit or corporate office to gather requirements and needs for an internet website for information or for business purposes. 
 Design and develop complex websites using SharePoint for use by business units or corporate offices and by external clients through an e-business enterprise. 
 Assist in creating and designing documentation used by development team members to ensure compliance with departmental policies and procedures. 
 Perform complex web application implementation, including application coding and testing. Provide technical analysis of business unit or corporate office requirements. 
 Provide support to maintaining current website(s) by updating code and design. May provide guidance and assistance to less experienced web developers. 


 If my requirement matches your resume, then please do reply on my email id alih (at) usmsystems(dot)com  and contact no is 703-955-3955
